summary:
Accepted. No blockers found in the DODGE-073 directory/setup and registration delta.

The config, host caller, source manifest, and directory contract match the four requested SHA-256 pins. All 29 source pins match the manifest and staged source. The caller checks the complete child directory set before claims or spawn, records prelaunch failure outside `output`, and creates `host-coordinator` once after preflight. The recorded DODGE-072 files remain unchanged.

The registration records Taylor’s Go for one separate successor with the same fresh-seed workload. The M1 snapshot reports active Mudcrab and Codex activity; it does not establish GPU-idle status. Live occupancy, null-lease CAS, MPS/RSS fit, and training behavior remain launch-time or runtime checks. This source review does not establish fresh-training fit or runtime success.
